caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with a rectangular shape and two large doors on the front. The cabinet is made of light brown wood, with visible grain patterns across its surface. Each door has a vertical panel design, with three recessed panels on each, framed by a simple border. There are small, dark-colored metal hinges attached to the sides of the doors, and a small round keyhole is present in the upper middle section where the two doors meet. The cabinet stands on short, curved legs, and the top has a slight overhang. The background is plain with a beige, slightly textured appearance. There are no other objects or decorative details in the composition.
title: Shaker Cabinet
